Package com.example.moogerscouncil

Class AvailabilityRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.moogerscouncil.AvailabilityRepository
public class AvailabilityRepository extends Object
Repository for slot documents stored under Slots/{counselorId}/slots.

Structure: Slots/{counselorAuthUID}/slots/{slotDocId}

Each counselor's slots live under their own branch keyed by Auth UID. Reads are a direct path lookup — no collection-wide scan or composite index needed.

      public void getSlotsForCounselor(String counselorId, AvailabilityRepository.OnSlotsLoadedCallback callback)

    • purgeExpiredUnbookedSlots

      public void purgeExpiredUnbookedSlots(String counselorId)
      Purges expired unbooked slots for a counselor from Firestore. A slot is purged if its date is strictly before today AND its available field is true — i.e. nobody booked it before the day passed. Booked slots (available=false) are kept because the counselor still needs them for notes/no-show actions.

      Fire-and-forget: runs as a single WriteBatch commit. Called on dashboard entry to keep the database tidy without a background timer.

      Parameters:
      counselorId - Firebase Auth UID of the counselor whose slots to purge.

    • addSlot

      public void addSlot(String counselorId, String date, String time, AvailabilityRepository.OnSlotActionCallback callback)
      Adds a new slot under Slots/{counselorId}/slots. Firestore creates the parent document implicitly on first write — no separate initialisation step is needed.
      Parameters:
      counselorId - Firebase Auth UID of the counselor.
      date - Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
      time - Time in "HH:mm" format.
      callback - Success/failure callback.

    • addSlotAndReturn

      public void addSlotAndReturn(String counselorId, String date, String time, AvailabilityRepository.OnSlotCreatedCallback callback)
      Adds a new slot and returns the created TimeSlot (with its Firestore ID) via callback. Use this variant when the caller needs the slot object — e.g. the waitlist auto-resolution hook in AvailabilitySetupActivity.
      Parameters:
      counselorId - Firebase Auth UID of the counselor.
      date - Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
      time - Time in "HH:mm" format.
      callback - Receives the created slot on success.
